{{Quote|I have just learned that there was a shipment recently delivered that may be useful to my superiors. I need you to find one named Terry. He has a record of the shipment in his datapad. Recover that datapad by any means necessary. I want no witnesses.|[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Snopel]], to a commando|<ref name="SWG:C" />}}
'''Terry''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] terrorist who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he inhabited the [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]], in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]].<ref name="SWG:C" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Snopel]], a retired [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]], tasked a commando under training to interrogate Terry about a shipment recently delivered to the station. The commando found Terry in the atrium of Tansarii Point Station, busy with planting a [[Bomb/Legends|bomb]]. The man indeed refused to answer any question and attacked the commando. Terry was killed in the ensuring [[lightfight]]. The commando later defused the bomb, saving Tansarii Point Station and its inhabitants.<ref name="SWG:C" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateThug.png|thumb|250px|Possible depictions of Terry]]
Terry appeared as a non-player character in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:C" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Terry was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:New Player Tutorial|New Player Tutorial]]," introduced with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
